description: The pear is the only brilliant cut with a directional axis — its pointed tip sets an orientation the eye is compelled to follow. Here that point draws the gaze along the length of the finger while the surrounding stones frame the centre without ever competing with it. The setting was designed around a single problem: holding the pear's tip in exactly the right position against the hand, so the stone always reads the way it was meant to. Eighteen-karat gold throughout.
